description: This pattern occurs when a distributed system validates the sender of a message (Envelope) and the signer of the data (Payload) independently, without enforcing that they must be the same entity.
trigger_condition: Processing a composite message where the outer envelope (transport) and inner payload (data) both contain identity claims.
test_template: 1. **Setup**: Initialize a cluster with N nodes. Identify the current privileged node (Target) and a non-privileged node (Attacker).
